title: EnCBP: A New Benchmark Dataset for Finer-Grained Cultural Background Prediction in English

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-corpus language model perplexity across news texts from different English-speaking countries and US states to measure cultural domain compatibility, and applying cultural feature augmentation (via two-stage training and multi-task learning) to downstream NLP tasks to reduce the out-sized influence of dominant regional linguistic styles.
